rules: Each record contains three distinct research-pass slots; all remain pending until evidence is recorded.
Do not invent the names of the seven unresolved Conscious Domains.
Do not silently equate roots, behavioral domains, blueprint archetypes, Jungian archetypes, Conscious Domains, cultural figures, or fetter mappings.
Add semantic parent/child relationships only when evidence supports the edge; unresolved links remain explicit work items.
ARCH12.json contains 18 entries despite its filename; taxonomy identity/count needs reconciliation.
Owner-stated material remains owner_stated_unverified until reconciled with primary project documentation.
